text:
Keisha: Flagging a batch issue  several interviewer reassignments from last-night's bulk change lost their attached scorecard templates on the calendar invites. Recruiters started noticing around 08:00.

Amit: Which batch? any common operation?

Keisha: It was the "interviewer-reassign" bulk job (job id: br-2026-03-22). Affected ~14 panels across EMEA and NA. Invite metadata shows `attached_template_id` empty after the job.

Lena: I pulled the job logs  looks like we normalize interviewer identities (email canonicalization) and then re-create assignments. The reassign flow calls `create_invite` without passing through `attach_scorecard()` if `legacy_identity=true`. Snippet from logs:

```
INFO bulk-reassign br-2026-03-22 start
processing panel=PNL-992
normalize_interviewer: j.smith+eng@company.com -> jsmith@company.com
create_invite(panel, interviewer=jsmith)
# attach_scorecard skipped: legacy_identity flag set
```

Trent: That `legacy_identity` short-circuit was added in 2025 to avoid double-writing for orgs with mixed SSO. We must have missed the scorecard path.

Amit: Short-term: can we patch invites for today's affected panels?

Keisha: Recruiters want a safe backfill. If we have panel->template mapping in DB we can re-run attach job for those panel ids.

Lena: We do have mapping. I'll write a small idempotent backfill script that: 1) query panels where invite.attached_template_id is null and panel.template_id != null 2) call attach_scorecard(panel_id, template_id) 3) log before/after.

Trent: Add a concurrency guard so we don't create duplicate invites if the scheduler is touching the same panels. Use optimistic lock on panel row.

Keisha: Also note one recruiter reported an interviewer received two invites (one with template, one without). Might be due to canonicalization producing two different identities in the same org.

Amit: For longer-term fix: remove the legacy_identity short-circuit in the reassign flow and centralize invite creation to one path that always calls attach_scorecard after invite persistence. Also add a unit test that fails if invite created with null attached_template when panel.template_id exists.

Lena: I'll open PR: remove short-circuit + add idempotent attach and test. ETA: 6h.

Keisha: Monitoring ask: can we add an alert when % of invites without attached_template > 0.5% in 1h window? Recruiting wants early warning.

Trent: I'll add metric `invite_missing_template_count` and set a pager if >10 in 1h for production. Non-pager alert for staging/dev.

recruiting-bot: Runbook suggestion: For backfill runs include: job id, author, dry-run flag, sample panel list, and cutoff window. Use ticket subject "Backfill: AttachTemplates".

Keisha: Also need to surface to interviewers who already submitted via email. Some PDFs came in and need to be reconciled to candidate records. Can ops assist with bulk attach?

Amit: Ops can accept a CSV (candidate_id, interviewer_email, timestamp, attachment_url) and we'll run a reconcile tool that uploads and links the PDFs to the right panel submission. Requires recruiter signoff.

Lena: I'll produce the panel list and push the backfill PR to staging first. Will run dry-run and share sample patch results.

Trent: After PR merge I'll deploy metric + alert and then approve backfill run.

Keisha: Thanks. Action list: Lena (PR + backfill script), Amit (reconcile tool + runbook), Trent (metrics + alert), Keisha (coordinate recruiters + collect PDFs). Reopen if anything else crops up. :thumbsup:
